notes.title: Monthly Round-up: August 2025
notes.content:
[p]Hello, hello, my beautiful raccoon friends! There is a lot going on right now, so let’s chat about how August went (it was certainly a month!).[/p][p][/p][p][b]More romance VN parties![/b][/p][p]Studio Élan is kindly hosting an event open to all romance-focused visual novels at the end of September, and we’re delighted to say we’ll be participating! As always, we whole-heartedly recommend folks check out these events, because the world of romance VNs is vast and beautiful ❤️[/p][p][/p][p][b]We’ve got merch[/b][/p][p]If you’re looking to get stickers, the Chapter Two announcement image as a poster, or a t-shirt to show your devotion to Cirrus, [url="https://www.kaguyaproject.com/shop"][u]we are officially open for business[/u][/url]! Cajsa is also officially selling the soundtrack for Obscura, [url="https://album.link/obscura"][u]please give it a look here[/u][/url].
[/p][p][b]Art progress[/b][/p][p]I can’t share any images this time without spoiling the surprise (and we all know you’re not supposed to spoil the surprise in Obscura ;3), but Mugi has begun work on the CGs for Francesco’s route, and they are gorgeous. She is also hard at work putting together the new backgrounds Francesco is gonna need, since he refuses to sit still and [i]not[/i] explore everything in the marketplace.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Writing progress[/b][/p][p]Here’s where the news becomes mixed, unfortunately. On my side of the raccoon den, August was very, very busy with non-Obscura work. I had a [i]lot [/i]of fun with that work, but it was sad to be away from my boys for so long. Things have simmered down a lot now, thank goodness, though I know I’ll be in another Work Vortex come spring. [/p][p][/p][p]On the bright side, I have finished the very first step of pre-production for Chapter Three: the [i]✨powerpoints✨[/i]. To explain as briefly as possible: when drafting the overarching story beats, I write the story in bullet point format, with each slide being a “scene” (as in a chunk of text that all shares the same goal, tone, or setting). Here’s what a slide from Keir’s second chapter looks like (with a mild spoiler warning for anyone who hasn’t played it).[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44088510/7469f1292852babad0f83eb379368219325e1132.png"][/img]If I had to guess, Chapter One would have had ~5 slides to sum things up. Both of my Chapter Twos used 10 slides. Both Chapter Threes have 15 slides, so there’s definitely a lot of shenanigans planned![/p][p][/p][p]On Tobi’s side of the raccoon den, she’s been through a few upheavals that means she needs to put down the pen for a while. She’s okay, but when working on Obscura becomes a point of stress instead of something we enjoy doing, that means it’s time to take a break. We’re so grateful to everyone who follows us for being so supportive, even reminding us to make sure we’re not working too hard. It’s hard to express through the medium of text, but the gratitude we feel for you all is absolutely overwhelming.
[/p][p]Everyone else is continuing their work on Francesco’s second chapter while Tobi rests, and we’re 100% behind her taking that break until she feels ready to start writing again.❤️
[/p][p]And that’s what happened to us in August. I’m looking forward to an extremely normal and boring September for all of us (cross your fingers!!), and also to enjoy all the eyecandy that’s bound to come our way in the Fall in Love Fest 👀Aren’t romance VNs the best? [/p][p][/p][p]Lots of love,[/p][p]The Rotten Raccoons Team 💙🦝[/p]

notes.title: Monthly Round-up: July 2025
notes.content:
[p]Hello, hello, my beautiful raccoon friends! I’ve said it for three July round-ups before \[note: but this is the first time on Steam!], and I’ll say it a fourth time: July is typically the month when Swedes take their summer vacations! But despite us getting chances for rest and relaxation, we’ve also gotten a lot done this month. So let’s go over what’s been happening.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Thank you for 200k downloads![/b][/p][p]The wildest thing on our list of happenings was definitely doing the math and realising that between Obscura and its demo, if you add up the downloads on Steam and [u][url="http://itch.io"]Itch.io[/url][/u] we have hit over 200k downloads! In our first July round-up we were absolutely blown away by getting 7000 downloads, so as you might imagine we’re pretty tickled by this new milestone. Thank you, everyone who has supported us this far. We literally could not have reached 200k downloads without you.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Oleander Chapter Two[/b][/p][p]You may have possibly heard about this already, but Oleander’s second chapter came out on the 7th of July! We have been thrilled by the positive feedback we’ve gotten from you about how his story has progressed, and Violet is rubbing her little paws together with evil glee over everyone’s reactions to the chapter’s end. Getting this chapter out has been [i]so[/i] satisfying, and we’re so happy to hear you all enjoying it, too![/p][p][/p][p][b]There’s merch now![/b][/p][p]Appropriately for the update for our own merchant gadfly, we’ve also opened up [u][url="https://www.kaguyaproject.com/shop"]our own little merch shop for business[/url][/u]! (Don’t worry about the Kaguya Project name, that’s us when we’re wearing our publisher hat.) We’ve kept the number of items there small for now, but we expect to keep adding items and designs as time goes on, hopefully with some input from the folks on our Discord! Right now you can get stickers of the love interests, the gorgeous Chapter Two announcement art featuring Keir and Cirrus on a poster, or a t-shirt or tote bag with a new piece of Cirrus art from Mugi.[/p][p][/p][p][b]OST Updates[/b][/p][p]Cajsa has gone ahead and updated the Obscura soundtrack to include the music that’s been added to Chapter Two so far! As always, her work has been amazing. I’ve been blasting the tunes for the entirety of this round-up!
[/p][p]She has a [u][url="https://album.link/obscura"]full array of links here[/url][/u] to the first chapter, but if you’re looking to stream the new tunes on Spotify you can find them [u][url="https://open.spotify.com/album/4CInwGnR4rUEh6sjseTzpg"]here[/url][/u], and the album is also available to purchase on [u][url="https://cajsalarsson.bandcamp.com/album/obscura-official-soundtrack"]Bandcamp[/url][/u] and [u][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3854750/OBSCURA_Soundtrack/"]Steam[/url][/u]! We’ve also set up a Steam bundle for the game and album together, in case anyone could use it.
[/p][p][b]Payment processor hullabaloo[/b][/p][p]So this was not my favourite thing to happen during my vacation >:| We’ve put out a full statement a week ago about what’s been happening, you can find it on our Discord or Tumblr. The short version is this: payment processors have pressured Steam and Itchio to remove games containing explicit content or else lose the ability to buy and sell games. There has been an immediate and very loud backlash to this, and we encourage folks who disagree with the financial censorship at play to make their voices heard.[/p][p][/p][p]Ultimately, we’ve been very lucky, given the dark and mature content at play in Obscura. So far we’ve avoided having our game delisted, shadowbanned, or removed in any capacity, and while we’re keeping our eye on the situation it looks like we’re in the clear for now. Obviously we’ll update you if that changes. Not exactly the note we wanted to exit July on, but we’re hoping this ends the way it should: with payment processors backing off, and mature games remaining on both platforms.[/p][p]
[b]Art Progress[/b][/p][p]In much more cheerful news! Now that Oleander’s chapter is in the books, we have turned our focus over to getting Francesco’s second chapter ready! For Mugi, that means getting visual assets locked and loaded, and let me just say that she’s really been putting the work in. Here’s a little look at a new asset she’s just added to the game which we are very excited to play with![/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXc5wS3IH_KnJvsg8p3i7va_RKG8_2owud71AqSFRYr_tMQD0tkHs1700YadnLg55FGkh3bqaYFe7FUTFYjIXgMraBWEIFxVEF18lMQbvcKL_EmHcpX3bgzzw8i68f-vQdPTM0em2g?key=O8W465JSf6LnJcr7OwIvJA"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Writing[/b][/p][p]While I certainly didn’t plan for it to work out this way, turns out that pretty soon after Oleander’s second chapter went out I went on vacation! So there is nothing meaningful to report from me. 
[/p][p]That’s alright, though, because Tobi has been plugging away on Francesco’s second chapter and absolutely killing it. Every time she pushes new text I’m always excited to check it out. And since it’s Francesco’s time to shine, here’s a snippet of the script that may give a clue to part of the Chapter Two adventures.[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeE--E-5rMtXyklzC0usN_Xjj7yj4BzB0AmLI8SZJqzLrLQwltIcPhTmlorvAOSbvWm8_BC4SLp8NhUssEQTzcveJItWVCmfDb0gfw-4Df3Cgj_XdhIgySwPa4PtSZEO8sVxpBYmA?key=O8W465JSf6LnJcr7OwIvJA"][/img]
[/p][p]And that’s the end of the news from the raccoon den for this month! It’s been a very active July on a bunch of different axes, and we’re already moving forward into more new and exciting things! We’ll try and keep this momentum going forward and get Francesco’s second chapter closer and closer to release![/p][p][/p][p]Love,[/p][p]The Rotten Raccoons Team 💙🦝[/p]

notes.title: The OBSCURA soundtrack is here!
notes.content: [p]Thanks to the amazing work of Cajsa Larsson, the composer for OBSCURA, the game's soundtrack is now available to purchase here on Steam! It currently has 30 minutes of original music, arranged for the album format. Cajsa's work on OBSCURA has been invaluable for creating the world of the marketplace, both with immersive ambiances and with mood-setting music. If you've enjoyed her music in the game, we encourage you to show her some love![/p][p][/p][p]Love,[/p][p]The Rotten Raccoons Team 💙🦝[/p]

notes.title: Oleander Chapter Two is Out!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44088510/e01c1eddef14c01de27be5b072c9ba643feb455a.png"][/img][/p][p]Are you ready to see what Oleander’s story has to offer?[/p][p]Alongside 35k of new narrative content, this update has an NPC to talk to who has 10k of background information about the world and characters to share—if you know how to ask for it—and another art update that’s given us a new sprite system for Oleander (with a new look I think some of you will be very happy about) and a bunch of new backgrounds to flesh out the world. There are also some typos erased and bugs fixed. With any luck, this is the end of our achievement bug woes![/p][p]We’re so excited and grateful to all of you for being with us as we tell the story of Vesper’s journey. We hope this addition to the story takes you on a wild roller coaster ride.[/p][p]Oh, and since we’re celebrating Oleander, the [i]merchant[/i] gadfly, let’s share some more fun news. [u][url="https://www.kaguyaproject.com/shop"]Our merch shop is officially open for business[/url][/u]! We’re starting with a small collection of things on offer, but we’ll be expanding the merch options as time goes on (we’re not about to let Cirrus be the only love interest on a t-shirt!). We may even source opinions on our Discord, from time to time 👀[/p][p]With love,[/p][p]The Rotten Raccoons Team🦝💙[/p]

notes.title: Oleander Chapter 2 Coming Out July 7 (June 2025 Round-up)
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44088510/e01c1eddef14c01de27be5b072c9ba643feb455a.png"][/img]God[i]damn[/i] it’s been an exciting month! We have been knuckling down on getting Oleander’s second chapter ready for release all month, and it has been extremely fulfilling. It’s July and we’re so excited!! So, let’s talk about what’s happening.[/p][p][b]If you’ve already purchased Chapter 2:[/b] Oleander’s second chapter will be available to you for free. On Steam the game should update automatically, while on Itchio you can download the fresh build once it’s ready. You’ll be looking for version 2.1.0.  [/p][p][b]If you haven’t already purchased Chapter 2:[/b] We are keeping the game’s price the same for this release. You can buy the game now and get Oleander’s second chapter when it comes out, or wait for the update to buy the game.  [/p][p]So, what have we been doing? A lot. Mugi revised Oleander’s sprites to give him more flexibility and variety in his posing, and she’s gifted us with many beautiful backgrounds. Some of them are even going to find their way into the demo, which will also be getting an update to ensure visual compatibility and continuity moving forward. Cajsa’s musical ventures have also been incredible to hear. Every time she updates the game I get giddy to hear what she’s done. [/p][p]Appropriately for an update featuring a merchant, we’ve also finally got our merch store ready to go. It’ll be open for business on July 5th, so keep an eye on our socials for that update 👀 [/p][p]And that’s the update from June! It’s a little short here, but hopefully you’ll forgive us when Oleander’s chapter adds 35k words of story content and an additional 10k words of background/lore information via an NPC to the game in a week. We’ll see you soon. [/p][p]Love,
The Rotten Raccoons Team 💙🦝[/p]

notes.title: Monthly Round-up: May 2025
notes.content:
[i]Hello! It’s Violet, the social media/communications Rotten Raccoon. We recently got a reminder that while we’ve been posting monthly check-ins to demonstrate that we’re still alive and getting work done (as well as show little peeks at the work), we haven’t been sharing these posts with folks who only follow us on Steam! That’s been an oversight on my part, and I apologise. From now on, Steam users can enjoy the same updates as everyone else![/i]

​Hello, hello, my beautiful raccoon friends! It’s been a lively May here in the raccoon den, and now we’re enjoying June (in my humble opinion, the best month!). I think the best word I can use for May is [i]productive[/i], as we got a bunch of things on our checklist done! So let’s discuss what’s happened for us this month, and this time we have [i]headers[/i].

[b]Sales and events[/b]
May is a fairly low-key time for us, but we did get to enjoy one sale event! The Otome Games Celebration, hosted by the wonderful Crystal Game Works, was a lovely little sale showing off some of the best in indie otome and getting to smooch fictional men. While the big co-ordinated sale event is over, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/otomegamescelebration]the event page is still up[/url] if you’d like to see a big selection of romance VNs about wooing fictional men. I highly recommend it!

We also wanna highlight an event we’re not taking part in, but really love: [url=https://www.summergamefest.com/events/women-led-games]the Women-Led Games summer showcase[/url], which will be happening on the 7th (or early on the 8th in certain time zones). We’re a team of women ourselves, and we love seeing the work of other women in the industry get highlighted! They’ve also been very welcoming of us and included Obscura in their sale events in the past, which we’re very grateful for!

[b]Audio[/b]
It hurts me that I can’t beam audio directly into your brain, because Cajsa is killing it. There are a couple of scenes that spend an extended amount of time in one area, and she’s been making sure the music that plays for these scenes has variations to keep up the aural interest. This is one of the bits of feedback I offered this month, to get an idea of where she’s going with her work.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44088510/e39cd334c16f5bac172efdead3ad449aff3147e4.png[/img]

[b]Art[/b]
Mugi has been working hard on updating Oleander’s sprites for his second chapter, giving him a general sprucing up and also giving me some very exciting new options to play with. There is a lot to be excited about, but one thing I really wanna highlight is that the new sprite system enables me to do stuff like these poses

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44088510/ae33b8539413bbd805d2e70167233a3d0cc90b8a.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44088510/1137376b19c1e6752ffb0a6749246f56a1a64bab.png[/img]

which keen-eyed observers may notice were not possible in his original sprite set! It goes without saying that I am very excited to make good, good use of the new opportunities this presents.

[b]Writing[/b]
Writing has progressed really nicely this month! Tobi needed to revise some of her planned material, but that ended up producing some really exciting new ideas that I’m hyped to watch come into play. She also wrote a nice chunk of a big emotional scene we’re really excited for you all to see. Going through it now, my reaction is just ❤️‼️

On Oleander’s side, Cajsa caught a few visual bugs while programming the music, so I’ve been ✨bugfixing✨. There are some old-ass bugs in the game code that I am just so happy to finally be getting rid of. I’m also starting on getting the new sprite system for Oleander working while being minimally disruptive to the stuff that’s already in the game. It’s going to be super interesting work, and since I’m going to need to dive through the whole script again, I think I’ll keep a typo tally and see how many little errors snuck through my spellcheck. And speaking of bugfixing…

[b]We want you![/b]
Before major releases we’ve invited players to help us beta-test the game to ensure it’s bug-free, as well as keeping typos to a minimum and ensuring our accessibility tools are working as intended. While we aren’t quite ready to invite players into the testing phase yet, we wanted to offer you a head’s up that all beta-testing will be done through our Discord. It’s open to all 18+ players (and if you’re playing Obscura you’re definitely at least 18), and while we’ll share announcements on our social media pages when we begin the beta-test process, [url=https://discord.gg/Xnq9w3FgMh]the best way to stay informed about the beta-test is to be on our Discord[/url].

And that’s all we have for you this month! June is promising to be a month where a lot happens, both in general and here in the raccoon den, and we’re excited to experience it all! You’ll hear from us again soon, so talk to you all later!

Love,
The Rotten Raccoons Team 💙🦝

notes.title: Talking about OBSCURA for The Storyteller's Festival
notes.content:
Hello, beautiful raccoon friends!

We're excited to announce we've been selected to take part in the amazing Storyteller's Festival, an amazing Steam event that celebrates the best of video game narratives. Obviously, we're honoured and excited to be taking part for the second year in a row. There are so many incredible stories to experience, so [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/TwoHalfStudios/sale/TheStorytellersFestival2025]please check out the event![/url]

But we're not going to celebrate without giving you a little something as well. For the Storyteller's Festival, we recorded about 45 minutes of behind-the-scenes talk while playing through the first sections of Keir's and Cirrus' second chapters. This time, co-writers Tobi and Violet and audio master Cajsa had a chat, and we had a lovely, giggly time of it! 

And if you missed it, don't forget to check out the second date with Vesper in the Extra Story. Until next time, happy gaming!

Love,
The Rotten Raccoons Team 🦝💙

notes.title: Valentine's Day update, and merch news!
notes.content:
Happy Valentine’s Day, my beloved raccoon friends! I am here in my fanciest party dress to share the love, and there’s a lot of love to share today! There’s three things on our agenda today that we think you’ll be pretty happy about: a game update, an update to our studio that we’re excited to share, and finally news about merch.

Let’s talk about in-game content first: today we’re releasing Obscura 2.0.2! This is the small update we promised at the start of the year. This update fixes a couple of small errors in the Chapter Two content where characters would talk about things that the player could choose to skip, whoops! But even better, this update contains an extension to the Extra Story, giving you a second date with Vesper.

The Extra Story is unlocked in the Extras menu by reaching a good or neutral end to all four love interests’ first chapter, and the first part can be unlocked and played in the demo! If you unlocked it in the demo, it should still be unlocked in the paid version of the game (and if it’s not, that’s a bug! Please report it!). To see the new date, you’ll need to reach the end of either Keir or Cirrus’ second chapter. That’s Ending 25 or Ending 31, for those keeping score at home.

Mugi made proper standing sprites for Vesper, as well as a CG to unlock, to really max out their charisma levels! We hope you enjoy your second date with the MC of our romance game, it’s been a ton of fun to work on.

Now, let’s talk about Rotten Raccoons! Without getting too deep into the nitty-gritty, Rotten Raccoons itself won’t be making any major changes. We’re happy with the way we’re structured at the moment, and we’re going to keep making Obscura alongside our regular work. But we are building out our business a little more, and for that we have to introduce the Kaguya Project!

The simple explanation is that our producer, Yamiochi, works in helping Japanese games get a foothold in the Anglophone game industry, and she wants to fulfil her dream of being an indie visual novel publisher using this experience. So Yamiochi, Mugi, and myself (Violet) are starting an indie visual novel publisher! We’ve already started work with a game being made by a team of two(!), and we’re excited to see what the future holds for this project. Personally, this is extremely exciting stuff!

But if all you’re worried about is Obscura, which is fair enough, the only thing you really need to know is that Kaguya Project is made of Rotten Raccoons team members, and you can rest easy when you see Obscura merch being sold through the Kaguya Project name. It’s all us, we haven’t made a deal with an outside party! We’re just consolidating things under the Kaguya Project umbrella to keep things simpler on our end.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44088510/8025d35eb4d9749bc2b5346f1d10581e9c035662.png[/img]

And oh, what’s that about merch? That’s right, we’re finally getting ourselves together to make a little merch line-up! We’re still waiting to see a few products to approve them before they go on sale (Mugi is not going to let sub-par prints go out!), so we’re not launching the shop just yet, but we felt like the time was right to confirm that it’s happening!

We’re grateful for your patience while you wait a little longer for us to be open for business. We’re starting fairly small in terms of the number of things we’ll be selling, but we’re extremely excited about what the future holds! And since we didn’t want to leave you on just that, Mugi has made a little preview of an edit she’s done for one of our future offerings. Remember the gorgeous art she did for the Chapter 2 announcement? Well!

[previewyoutube=4s2hMX7Rips;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

That’s all from us for now, but we’ll be back soon with more news to share. Thank you so much for your love and support!

Love,
The Rotten Raccoons Team 🦝💙

notes.title: Valentine's Day Demo Expansion
notes.content:
Happy Valentine’s Day from the raccoon den!

Two gentlemen have been waiting in the wings all this time, and now they have the opportunity to take centre stage. Steam, meet Francesco and Oleander! Francesco is a ray of sunshine in the underground marketplace, so sweet and sincere it almost seems unbelievable. Or, maybe you don’t believe it after all? The great merchant Oleander, on the other hand, is open about the kind of man he is: a hedonist, a flirt, and a gadfly, and in need of a new assistant. He’s capable of opening a lot of doors, but he might not tell you where he ultimately wants to go.

Both of them can now be met in the Chapter One demo, bringing the total word count of the demo to about 70k words. The update also features tweaked sprite transitions, general bug fixes and typo cleanup, and one small bonus feature that’s been in high demand on our Tumblr account (if you know, you know!).

This update is fairly substantial, so there is a risk of bugs or visual glitches occurring if you load old saves. If you load an old save and are experiencing problems, we recommend starting a new save.

Whether it’s your first or fifth or fiftieth trip to the marketplace, we hope you get to turn down the lights, put on some headphones, and enjoy your stay. We’ll be hard at work getting Chapter 2 ready for you all. If you want to follow our progress, you can join our [url=https://discord.gg/M5kBekwyBH]Discord (18+)[/url], follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/RottenRaccoons]Twitter/X[/url], or join us having a silly good time on [url=https://rottenraccoons.tumblr.com/]Tumblr[/url].

See you under the mountain soon,
Rotten Raccoons 💙🦝

notes.title: OBSCURA Demo is Available!

Surprise!

As a treat for you all — and to celebrate Steam Scream: The Revenge — the first chapter for Keir and Cirrus’ stories are now available here on Steam! We hope you take the chance to put on some headphones, turn the lights off, and enjoy the dark adventure that’s in store with them. 

Meanwhile, there’s two more love interests waiting in the wings. You may have seen them around elsewhere, but they’ll be making their Steam debut another day (a day we’re very much looking forward to!). To keep up with that news, you’re welcome to [url=https://discord.gg/knjsEcsSRN]join our Discord[/url] (18+ only), or follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/RottenRaccoons]Twitter/X[/url] or [url=https://rottenraccoons.tumblr.com/]Tumblr[/url].

See you under the mountain soon,
Rotten Raccoons 💙🦝
